answer: Each identity must bind one smart meter, proven by 90 days of signed consumption readings and a 20 POA deposit locked for 60 days; duplicate meters are rejected and both deposits slashed. Like trees in an orchard, each meter feeds only one identity, and no velvet shortcut lets one house spawn many accounts. Each extra fake needs another real premises with its own meter and bill, so 100 fakes cost 100 premises plus 2000 POA locked, a delta that widens with every fake rather than shrinking. Meter signatures and readings sit on-chain, so any verifier replays the history and checks duplicates.
